detection_signature_precision.value: MATCHES (safe to xfail) ONLY when ALL FIVE hold for a failing test: (1) its test file is experiment-specific (tests/python/test_experiment_*.py or test_exp*.py -- never a core/shared test); (2) its failure block references a results/*.json path P; (3) P is a declared `deliverable` of a task in the CURRENT research-roadmap.yaml; (4) P does NOT exist on disk at repo_root/P (the producing task's main() has not delivered); (5) its failure block carries a file-absence marker (FileNotFoundError / 'No such file or directory' / '[Errno 2]' / JSONDecodeError). CORRECTLY DOES NOT MATCH (keeps blocking the gate): a plain AssertionError with no results path (test_unrelated_assertion_failure_does_not_match); a results path that is NOT a declared roadmap deliverable, e.g. a typo/stale path (test_results_path_not_in_roadmap_does_not_match); a deliverable that IS present on disk but the test still fails -- that is a real assertion bug (test_deliverable_present_on_disk_does_not_match); a test that names a pending deliverable but fails on a VALUE assertion rather than a missing-file error (test_missing_absence_marker_does_not_match); a core/shared test (test_pipeline_*, docs, cli) even when it references a pending deliverable (test_core_test_is_never_triaged); and a poison-wait mixed with a genuine failure yields all_failures_explained==False so the gate still blocks (test_mixed_real_and_poison_failure_still_blocks). xfail is scoped to the single matched test node (never a blanket module skip), and its condition re-checks the deliverable's on-disk absence on every collection, so it self-expires the instant the file lands.
detection_signature_precision.principle: An over-broad triage rule would silently mask real regressions -- exactly the failure mode Tests-Must-Run-And-Assert exists to prevent. Precision here is the safety property: the five-part conjunction plus the experiment-specific-file gate plus the on-disk-absence recheck together ensure only the narrow deliverable-read-before-produced signature is ever xfailed, and only while the deliverable is genuinely absent.
